rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only recovery student needs real direction-diverse TRAIN recovery states under the strongest confirmed local controller.
observable_information: Seven-row pixel road visibility, near-road pixel center, pixel obstacle flag, and decision index trigger a fixed pulse; four-frame pixels and inherited actions are saved at privileged teacher interventions.
allowed_action_or_state_change: In TRAIN only, inject one fixed left or right steering pulse, then label low-visibility states with a simulator-privileged recovery teacher; no submission runtime changes.
expected_success_endpoint: Across six fresh TRAIN cells, each pulse arm completes eight decisions on at least four cells, at least three left-pulse cells yield positive teacher steer and at least three right-pulse cells yield negative steer, with 18 attempted episodes and zero invalid actions.
control: Exact bend-rebound ZIP SHA-256 8f7e87c29e92caf49db0070842dbc30f21a20ff98a3f48bf17d9599490559e49, with an unpulsed arm on each cell.
falsifier: Too few complete pulses, too few opposite-direction real teacher labels, invalid data/hash/action or incomplete 18-episode denominator.
smallest_decisive_experiment: TRAIN tracks 1-3 x seeds 5140-5141, each with unpulsed, left-pulse and right-pulse arms; teacher-only activation diagnostic.
resource_and_risk_gate: One SHA-registered Linux CPU local diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds, two cores, 2 GiB and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
